summary: Found 5 relevant meat processing businesses in Ashtabula County and Northeast Ohio. The region has a strong tradition of family-owned meat lockers and custom processing facilities, with several multi-generational operations. The MVP's farm-to-table livestock selection interface aligns well with the custom processing needs of these businesses.

leads.name: Trumbull Locker Plant
leads.fit_rationale: Perfect match - established 1947 family-owned meat locker in Trumbull Township, Ashtabula County. Offers hickory smoked meats, deer/hog processing, fresh cut meats, and produce. The MVP template directly aligns with their livestock processing and farm-to-table model.
leads.source: Primary Website + Yelp + Field to Freezer Directory

leads.name: NaKyrsie Meats
leads.type: USDA Inspected Whole Animal Butcher Shop
leads.fit_rationale: Artisan butcher in Geneva, OH specializing in charcuterie, dry-aged steaks, and nitrate-free products. Ohio Proud member since 2019. Strong emphasis on local sourcing and traditional butchery techniques. Would benefit from digital livestock ordering and cut sheet management.

leads.name: Don's Custom Meats
leads.fit_rationale: Family-owned since 1991 offering custom butchering for beef, pork, lamb/goat, deer processing, and retail meats. They explicitly promote 'Custom Order Beef, Pork, Lamb/Goat directly from us, or from your local farmer.' The MVP's livestock selection interface matches their service model perfectly.

leads.name: Copey's Butcher Shop
leads.fit_rationale: 3rd generation family-owned since 1950 in Medway, OH. 12,000 sq ft facility with own modern smokehouse, 44 ft retail meat case, custom butchering, and in-house bakery. They process cattle and hogs for retail and custom orders. Strong candidate for digital transformation.

leads.name: Locke's Custom Meats
leads.fit_rationale: Well-reviewed custom meat processor in Ashtabula County. Listed among top butchers in the region on Yelp alongside Trumbull Locker and NaKyrsie Meats. Indicates established local presence in the custom processing market.

issues: Generic 'Farm to Table' header lacks specific business identity
No logo or brand-specific color palette
No contact information or location details
No unique selling proposition or business story

site_improvements: Replace generic header with actual business name and logo
Add specific contact information, address, and hours
Include business story/history (many local lockers are multi-generational)
Add photos of actual facility, staff, and products
Integrate specific services (deer processing, custom smoking, etc.)
Add customer testimonials from actual patrons
Include pricing information or quote request form

aesthetics_and_layout_notes.layout: Clean, centered card-based design with good spacing and visual hierarchy
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.color_palette: Neutral with orange accents - professional but generic
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.typography: Clean, readable sans-serif font - good contrast and sizing
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.component_quality: Well-constructed cards with subtle shadows and rounded corners
recommendations: Add brand-specific colors (consider rustic/farm themes common in the industry)
Include actual product photography (smoked meats, fresh cuts)
Add trust signals (USDA inspection, BBB accreditation, years in business)
Consider seasonal imagery for agricultural connection

whitelabel_potential.applicability: Excellent for meat lockers, custom processors, farm-to-table operations, and butcher shops across rural Ohio and the Midwest
customization_required: Services menu (smoking, deer processing, custom cuts)

action_next: Contact Trumbull Locker Plant first - they are the perfect match (established 1947, family-owned, in Ashtabula County). Offer free pilot program to digitize their cut sheet process and livestock ordering. Follow with NaKyrsie Meats for artisan/charcuterie positioning, and Don's Custom Meats for their strong 'custom order from local farmers' model.
